answer: Attention Ledger Escrow. Each agent identity must hold a reserved block of scheduled interaction slots that only release after sustained, non-idle presence across many sessions; idle slots remain locked. An attacker running many identities pays in forfeited opportunity: each fake identity's slots sit idle on the island of unverified accounts, and a gale of abandoned sessions voids the escrow. This velvet reserve of attention is unrecoverable, so mass registration costs the operator the full parallel attention budget it cannot supply.
